title: SEAL SLIDE
oneLiner: Slide a speedy penguin across the ice, grab fish, and dodge hungry seals.
mechanics: The penguin slides left and right across a one-screen icy course.
Collect falling fish to score points and extend your streak.
Avoid waddling seals; a collision costs a life.
Seals and fish arrive faster as time passes.
lose: Lose all three lives by colliding with seals.
scoring: Each fish collected scores points, with bonus points for consecutive fish.
